Darth Maul'' |author=[[Jude Watson]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=[[March]] [[2000]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=97 |isbn=0439139414 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] |series=''[[Star Wars Journal]]'' |preceded by=[[Star Wars Journal: Queen Amidala|''Queen Amidala'']] |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars Journal: Darth Maul''''', also stylized as '''''Star Wars:'' Episode I ''Journal – Darth Maul''''' is a novel from the point of view of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] surrounding the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']]. There are twelve entries that Maul has written for the [[Sith archives/Legends|Sith Archives]]. Each show his past, his plans, and his missions, ending where he plans to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. An epilogue is made by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], reporting the supposed death of his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], as well as commenting on his failures and excellent skill as a swordsman. This short novel is mixed in with ''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''.
